ruling.recommended_action: Issue a $4.17 Ryde voucher refund for the unexempted detour distance on this RydeTAXI trip, and log the driver's breach of the shortest-and-most-direct-route obligation (RD-1) for account monitoring.

segment_findings.reason: Off-route segment 09:32–09:38 adding 2.96 km (up to 974 m from optimal route) with no exemption: RD-4 fails because there are no traffic incidents (F11) and only band-4 speeds on the alternatives (F9/F10), which is at most corroborating under RD-4(b) and cannot exempt; RD-5 fails because there are no chat messages at all (F7), so no pre-departure rider consent. Unexempted under RD-1; refunded per RD-2.

rejected_claims.reason: The rider seeks refund of the full billed excess of 3.2 km ($4.45), but RD-2 refunds only measured unexempted segment extra_km (2.96 km); the ~0.25 km map-matching residual is not refunded, giving $4.17.

Driver's claim that GPS rerouting made the deviation legitimate is unsupported: no traffic incident near the route (F11) and only band-4 speeds (F9/F10), insufficient under RD-4; no passenger consent existed (F7), so RD-5 does not exempt.
